name: adaptive-ml-code-gym
description: Adaptive beginner coaching for from-scratch machine learning coding katas.

interface.longDescription: A beginner-friendly coding gym for machine learning foundations. Its adaptive coach checks readiness, offers a five-question ability assessment, assigns an appropriate support level, selects suitable exercises, gives progressive hints, runs one kata safely, and guides reflection while respecting version boundaries.
capabilities: Run focused kata tests and explain failures
defaultPrompt: Assess my level and start a suitable ML kata.
Continue my current ML coding exercise.
Help me understand my first failing kata test.
